slides.texte_overlay:
self respect rules
for your twenties

don't beg for attention

if someone only replies when it suits them, stop chasing. the people who truly value you will make the effort to show up without ever needing to be asked.

dress for yourself

wear what makes you feel good, not what you think others expect. the way you treat yourself every morning quietly teaches people how to treat you too.

leave places that drain you

walk away from parties, groups and jobs that make you feel small. leaving early is not rude, it's a quiet way of respecting your own energy and precious time.

invest in your mind

your twenties are the best time to fill your mind with interesting things, a little every day. what you feed your mind now quietly shapes the person you'll be at thirty.
slides.texte_sophia:
invest in your mind

invest in your mind a little every day. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson, a planet or a painting, and 5 minutes a day now builds the person you'll be at thirty.

slides.texte_overlay:
keep your promises to yourself

if you say you'll go for a walk, go. every promise you keep to yourself builds the kind of deep self respect nobody else can ever take away from you again.
